sourceDescription: AnixQ — аниме с AnimeLib: каталог, плеер без рекламы, синхронизация с Shikimori.

appRepositories.appDescription:
New episodes, auto-download, franchise order, videos, trace.moe, random pick, Spotlight, stats, Siri, Live Activity, gestures

- Widgets: 'Скоро выходит' shows the next 36 hours (Shikimori keeps only the
  next episode per show), network error state, heartbeat + App Group status
  in Diagnostics; deployment target iOS 16.1
- 'Новая серия' badges and home shelf from AnimeLib episode counts for
  titles being watched; optional Wi-Fi auto-download of next episodes
- Title page: franchise watch order, trailers and OP/ED from Shikimori
- Search by screenshot via trace.moe (matched to AnimeLib by AniList id),
  'Что посмотреть?' random picker with filters, Spotlight indexing
- Statistics with yearly summary; Siri/Shortcuts intents; downloads Live
  Activity; gesture, double-tap step and speed memory settings
